what: Words and phrases stacked in the heading’s last-word slot swap every 5s. The current one blurs (.12em) and fades out over .38s ease-in, then the next arrives from blur .15em, 1.04× scale and transparent, sharpening over .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1). Each type (data-look) enters differently. typewriter types one character at a time in a typewriter face (90ms ±40%, sometimes typing a decoy, erasing and retyping) with a dwell of .45×. gradient is condensed uppercase with a rainbow band flowing over 6s, rising from .12em below over .65s. copy is condensed uppercase with an accent-color selection band switching on and off over .7s. If a word overflows the heading box, only that word’s letters shrink. Pauses when offscreen or when the tab is hidden.

options.in: Duration of entering from blur (s), default .7
options.fit: Element to measure overflow against (css), default nearest h1·h2
options.[data-fx-part=phrase]: Words to overlay — two or more. Put class on the one shown first="is-on". data-look="focus|typewriter|gradient|copy", typewriter uses data-decoy="Text typed by mistake, to be deleted"

use: to be trusted.to be read.to be seen
note: The original also has doodle (stroke mask + dripping), tattoo (dedicated typeface) and blood (Halloween) types, but they need dedicated fonts and glyph stroke paths, so they are not included
